project_title: New Alankar Jewellers - Luxury Storefront Blueprint

hero_background_guidelines.description: Curated photo of an Indian woman in a traditional sari and luxury gold jewellery
hero_background_guidelines.overlay_strategy: Use dual-layer gradient scrim overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-pearl/90 via-pearl/70 to-transparent for desktop, and subtle radial gradient) to guarantee 100% WCAG contrast readability for purple heading, gold eyebrow, and white/purple CTA buttons
hero_background_guidelines.hero_crest: Keep 'NEW ALANKAR JEWELLERS' crest and 'Symbol Of Purity' English badge prominent on the right/center arch frame
hero_background_guidelines.text_readability: All text over background must retain dark purple (#3b1254) or rich gold (#876f49) with high contrast background cards/backdrop blurs.

google_maps_section_guidelines.placement: Bottom of the page, directly above Footer or integrated inside showroom location section

marathi_labels.title: आमच्या शोरूमला भेट द्या
marathi_labels.subtitle: भेट देण्यापूर्वी फोन करून वेळ निश्चित करा.
marathi_labels.store_address: कासार गल्ली, सोमवार पेठ, तासगाव, महाराष्ट्र ४१६३१२

google_maps_section_guidelines.styling: Bordered luxury card in metallic gold with rounded frame, subtle shadow, interactive full-width map embed with direct opening link

Hero_jsx.action: Integrate traditional woman hero background with glass/scrim overlay while keeping existing 'Symbol Of Purity' tag and Marathi text completely readable.

MapSection_jsx.action: Create dedicated ShowroomMap component with Google Maps iframe embed, Marathi directions CTA button linking to https://share.google/ssEBGfxWdCO83eUnt, data-testid attributes.

Footer_jsx.action: Place ShowroomMap section right before the Footer section or integrate seamlessly.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements, inputs, CTA buttons, links, maps, and section headings MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.language_integrity: Keep all public facing headings in rich Marathi, retain 'Symbol Of Purity' and 'Symbol of Purity' in English, and private owner login in English.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.no_transparent_dropdowns: Never use fully transparent backgrounds behind text or dropdown menus.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.hover_states: All buttons must explicit set hover text colors (e.g., hover:bg-[#4a154b] hover:text-white).
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.no_fake_catalogs: Maintain real database/API logic for catalog items.
